items.mainDefect: Restarting a hung thread leaves the old worker running alongside its replacement on the same shards.

secondary.defect: Creating the replacement overwrites the existing SpansBuffer without closing it.

items.mainDefect: The restart path's multiprocessing.Process type check excludes SpawnProcess objects, so hung processes are not killed before replacements start.

secondary.defect: The same incorrect type check in join() prevents SpawnProcess workers from being terminated.
